description: BOMBSTOCK homepage assets. Relative paths work beside bombstock-design-system.html.
artwork_note: Stock logos and cutouts are pixel-art reconstructions of the supplied raster mockup, not official vector brand masters. The hero is one fixed image for all rarity states. No rarity color is baked into the sprite.
